spanish: Todos días de su nézer, desde todo lo que se haga desde vid del vino, desde granos hasta hollejo, no comerá.

findings.issue: H5145 is a common noun with a 3ms suffix, not a proper name; nézer leaves the lemma untranslated.
Morphology only licenses a plural noun then a singular noun in the from–until span; granos and hollejo lock grape-seed and grape-skin.
The conjunction on וְעַד is smoothed into hasta; the until-span remains.
Niphal imperfect 3ms is smoothed to subjunctive se haga; person, passive stem, and singular remain.

notes: Three min prepositions match the three desde; לא plus qal imperfect 3ms matches no comerá.
